name: Borstorf (Germany)
description: White field with narrow blue stripes along the top and bottom edges and a red horizontal bar across the middle, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Borstorf (a white tower on blue above crossed tools on red).
history: Municipal flag of Borstorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
